description: This Java source file defines an immutable logger class 'ImmutableDittoLogger' that wraps an SLF4J Logger. It provides thread-safe, immutable logging capabilities with support for MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries, including correlation IDs and custom headers, to enhance logging context in distributed applications. The class also includes an internal class 'MdcUsingLogger' to manage MDC context propagation during logging calls.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLogger
